show.description:
What if your dusty shop became the last hope of a war-torn dynasty? A mysterious back door, ancient gold, and a soldier desperate to save his people—this is no ordinary retail drama.
Get ready for a gripping ride through time, trust, and tactical biscuits. Watch Now !
